name: cursor-touchbar
description: Build your own Cursor control strip on the MacBook Touch Bar: any command, any icon, plus pages of saved prompts.

cursorTouchBar.showConfigButton.description: Show the gear button that opens the Cursor Touch Bar configuration panel.

cursorTouchBar.layout.markdownDescription: Buttons on the Touch Bar. Easiest edited from the panel: run **Cursor Touch Bar: Configure Buttons**, or tap the gear on the Touch Bar.

icon.description: Which bundled icon this button shows. Must be unique within its row.

label.description: Name shown in the configuration panel. Not drawn on the Touch Bar.

enabled.description: Uncheck to keep the button configured but off the Touch Bar.

enumDescriptions: Run a Cursor or VS Code command.
Replace the row with another page of buttons.
Open a new chat pre-filled with text. You still press Enter to send.

main.description: The main row, up to 10 buttons.

pages.description: Extra rows a "page" button can open. Each key is a page name.
